tool: Apex's browser build (pygbag 0.9.3, graphik 0.5.1's grid3d page, Strata 0.9.0's grid relay), built as .github/workflows/browser.yml does and driven with Playwright in headless Chromium (WebGL 2 on SwiftShader)
commands: local browser build of a22dfe7 (the CI steps), served on 127.0.0.1
Playwright, 1280x800: click to start, 'create new sim', 'start simulation' (20x20), screenshots taken as the simulation ran
frames cropped to the board, scaled to 640x400; clip.webm (VP9) and clip.mp4 (H.264), about 10 s, with darkroom 0.7.1's encoders; poster.jpg is a 28x28 run's first ticks
notes: A time-lapse, not real time: each screenshot of the software-rendered 3D view took seconds, so about 180 ticks are shown, a frame every few ticks. The same frames make the README GIF proposed for apex (pics/3d-play.gif).
